_description: Quatro brand palette tokens for technical diagrams. Paired with DataOS palette in the upstream technical-diagrams skill. Every Quatro diagram declares @brand: quatro at the top of its source file and renders with these tokens.

usage_rules.single_emphasis: Only one element per diagram gets forest fill. Two emphases equals emphasis lost.
usage_rules.ochre_scope: Ochre appears only on eco-track diagrams. Never on defense, federal capture, SATCOM, or any DataOS crossover.
usage_rules.brand_declaration: Every Quatro diagram source file must open with // @brand: quatro
usage_rules.font_stack: Roobert for headers, JetBrains Mono for labels at 10px. Reckless is not used in diagrams.
